messages:
maria (Docs): Quick note — I found an inconsistency in the /v1/embeddings API reference. The example request in docs/reference/endpoints/embeddings.md omits the required \"model\" field and the response example shows a top-level \"embedding\" object instead of the array under \"data\". This causes SDK examples to throw a 400 when users copy/paste.

ashwin (API): Thanks for catching this. Can you paste the offending snippet and the file path? I can update the OpenAPI schema if needed.

maria (Docs): Path: docs/reference/endpoints/embeddings.md (and the generated site page). Bad request example currently in the doc: ```json
{
  \"input\": \"hello world\"
}
```
Bad response example in the same page: ```json
{
  \"embedding\": [0.01, 0.02, 0.03],
  \"model\": \"embed-small\"
}
```

kevin (Eng): Yep that would fail the server-side validator — we require model + input. The canonical request should be: ```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood/embed-small-4096\",
  \"input\": \"hello world\",
  \"user\": \"team-xyz\"
}
```
And the response shape is: ```json
{
  \"object\": \"list\",
  \"data\": [
    {
      \"index\": 0,
      \"embedding\": [0.001, 0.002, 0.003]
    }
  ],
  \"model\": \"redwood/embed-small-4096\"
}
```

samantha (SDK): Can you also add the matching SDK snippet (python + curl) in the same PR? Our JS/Python examples assume the model key is present. If docs change, I'll update the SDK README example in the same PR or a follow-up.

maria (Docs): I'll open a docs PR to fix the markdown examples and add a short note in the endpoint description. Will also add a callout about the required \"model\" field.

ashwin (API): In addition to updating the markdown, we should patch api/openapi/embeddings.yaml — add `required: [model, input]` and a concrete example block. CI has an OpenAPI linter that should catch mismatch, but the generated site already shipped with the wrong example because the example came from an outdated snippet.

kevin (Eng): I'll run the validator locally and push the schema change. Command I use: `./scripts/validate-openapi.sh api/openapi/embeddings.yaml` — it fails currently with: `error: requestBody.example missing required property \"model\"`

maria (Docs): Cool. I'll put the PR in the `docs/embeddings-fix-model-example` branch. Assigning @kevin and @samantha for review.

docs-bot: New PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (maria/docs/embeddings-fix-model-example) :sparkles:

ashwin (API): Can we include a tiny migration note in the changelog: "Docs: embeddings example updated to include required model field and correct response shape" — helps support triage when users paste older examples.

samantha (SDK): Also adding an integration test to our examples repo that does a dry-run against staging to confirm shapes. I'll link it in the PR once it's green.

kevin (Eng): After PR merges, I'll send a small patch to the generator that feeds examples into the site so we don't regress. Also adding a unit test asserting example request has required keys.

maria (Docs): Action items: 1) I update markdown + add correct request/response examples. 2) @kevin update openapi schema + validator. 3) @samantha update SDK snippets and add integration test. 4) @ashwin add changelog entry.

ashwin (API): Sounds good. Thanks for catching this, @maria.

maria (Docs): Thanks all — I'll ping again when the PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
